chunks.title: AI Agent 可讀契約
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: What Is /goal
chunks.text: ## What Is /goal `/goal` is a Codex CLI mode for long-running, auditable work. Use it when the task spans multiple repos, requires inventory before edits, or needs a final completion audit.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: When To Use /goal
chunks.text: ## When To Use /goal Use it for dependency modernization, security triage, build reproducibility, release readiness, repository mapping, or documentation site maintenance. Do not use it to hide uncertainty; the final answer must still show evidence.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: How To Break Down Large Maintenance Work
chunks.text: ## How To Break Down Large Maintenance Work 1. Inventory repos, branches, build files, tests, CI, and licenses. 2. Map the affected component and legacy compatibility contract. 3. Select the smallest safe edit. 4. Run narrow tests first, then broader checks. 5. Update docs, diagrams, search index, and release notes. 6. Audit every explicit requirement before declaring completion.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: Ask AI To Inventory Before Editing
chunks.text: ## Ask AI To Inventory Before Editing A good prompt requires the agent to inspect current state, preserve dirty user work, and explain risk before touching code.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: Ask AI To Verify Every Step
chunks.text: ## Ask AI To Verify Every Step Require exact commands and evidence. Passing a build is not enough unless it covers the requested behavior.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: Ask AI To Avoid One Large Rewrite
chunks.text: ## Ask AI To Avoid One Large Rewrite Tell the agent to split code changes by repo and ownership boundary, especially for Cattle, server, agent, and database work.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: Copyable /goal Prompts
chunks.text: ## Copyable /goal Prompts ### 1. 建立 repository map code block ### 2. 分析 dependency risk code block ### 3. 修復 build failure code block ### 4. 升級單一 dependency code block ### 5. 修補 CVE code block ### 6. 建立 compatibility shim code block ### 7. 補測試 code block ### 8. 產生 release checklist code block ### 9. 對照 upstream 行為 code block ### 10. 重構但保持 API 相容 code block

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `AGENTS.md` - [Repository Map](/getting-started/repository-map/) - [Risk Matrix](/dependency-map/risk-matrix/) ### 允許動作 - Inventory, scoped edits, tests, docs updates, and release notes. ### 禁止動作 - Broad formatting, hidden major upgrades, deleting tests, removing EOL disclaimers, or using unlicensed images. ### 必要檢查 - Git status, repo ownership, compatibility risk, verification, rollback. ### 驗證 code block ### 回滾 Revert only the agent's changes and preserve user work. ### 輸出格式 Changed files, summary, tests run, tests not run and why, known risks, next steps.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: 人類維護者檢查清單
chunks.text: ## 人類維護者檢查清單 - Use `/goal` only for work that needs inventory, scoped execution, and completion audit. - Review the AI task summary before approving code changes. - Require concrete evidence for every stated success criterion.

chunks.title: Codex CLI /goal 指南
chunks.heading: AI Agent 檢查清單
chunks.text: ## AI Agent 檢查清單 - Inventory before editing and preserve user changes. - Split risky work into small verifiable steps. - Finish with changed files, tests, risks, rollback, and next steps.

chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。

chunks.title: Service API
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。

chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。

chunks.title: Agent Readable Contract
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### Must read first - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### Allowed actions - Inspect files and build metadata. - Propose small scoped edits. - Update documentation, diagrams, and verification evidence. ### Forbidden actions - Do not remove EOL/security disclaimers. - Do not perform broad formatting churn. - Do not change major dependencies without an explicit compatibility plan. - Do not delete tests to make a build pass. ### Required checks - Inspect git status before editing. - Identify affected repos and legacy compatibility surface. - Run the narrowest relevant validation commands. ### Verification Use the commands below as placeholders until a repo-specific command is proven. ### Rollback Revert only your own changes, preserve user work, and document why rollback was needed. ### Output format Return changed files, summary, tests run, tests not run and why, known risks, and next steps.

chunks.title: Codex CLI Goal Guide
chunks.heading: What Is /goal
chunks.text: ## What Is /goal `/goal` is a Codex CLI mode for long-running, auditable work. Use it when the task spans multiple repos, requires inventory before edits, or needs a final completion audit.

chunks.title: Codex CLI Goal Guide
chunks.heading: When To Use /goal
chunks.text: ## When To Use /goal Use it for dependency modernization, security triage, build reproducibility, release readiness, repository mapping, or documentation site maintenance. Do not use it to hide uncertainty; the final answer must still show evidence.

chunks.title: Codex CLI Goal Guide
chunks.heading: How To Break Down Large Maintenance Work
chunks.text: ## How To Break Down Large Maintenance Work 1. Inventory repos, branches, build files, tests, CI, and licenses. 2. Map the affected component and legacy compatibility contract. 3. Select the smallest safe edit. 4. Run narrow tests first, then broader checks. 5. Update docs, diagrams, search index, and release notes. 6. Audit every explicit requirement before declaring completion.

chunks.text: ## Ask AI To Inventory Before Editing A good prompt requires the agent to inspect current state, preserve dirty user work, and explain risk before touching code.

chunks.heading: Ask AI To Verify Every Step
chunks.text: ## Ask AI To Verify Every Step Require exact commands and evidence. Passing a build is not enough unless it covers the requested behavior.

chunks.heading: Ask AI To Avoid One Large Rewrite
chunks.text: ## Ask AI To Avoid One Large Rewrite Tell the agent to split code changes by repo and ownership boundary, especially for Cattle, server, agent, and database work.

chunks.title: Codex CLI Goal Guide
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### Must read first - `AGENTS.md` - [Repository Map](/getting-started/repository-map/) - [Risk Matrix](/dependency-map/risk-matrix/) ### Allowed actions - Inventory, scoped edits, tests, docs updates, and release notes. ### Forbidden actions - Broad formatting, hidden major upgrades, deleting tests, removing EOL disclaimers, or using unlicensed images. ### Required checks - Git status, repo ownership, compatibility risk, verification, rollback. ### Verification code block ### Rollback Revert only the agent's changes and preserve user work. ### Output format Changed files, summary, tests run, tests not run and why, known risks, next steps.

chunks.title: Codex CLI Goal Guide
chunks.heading: Human Maintainer Checklist
chunks.text: ## Human Maintainer Checklist - Use `/goal` only for work that needs inventory, scoped execution, and completion audit. - Review the AI task summary before approving code changes. - Require concrete evidence for every stated success criterion.

chunks.title: Codex CLI Goal Guide
chunks.heading: AI Agent Checklist
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Checklist - Inventory before editing and preserve user changes. - Split risky work into small verifiable steps. - Finish with changed files, tests, risks, rollback, and next steps.

chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### Must read first - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### Allowed actions - Inspect files and build metadata. - Propose small scoped edits. - Update documentation, diagrams, and verification evidence. ### Forbidden actions - Do not remove EOL/security disclaimers. - Do not perform broad formatting churn. - Do not change major dependencies without an explicit compatibility plan. - Do not delete tests to make a build pass. ### Required checks - Inspect git status before editing. - Identify affected repos and legacy compatibility surface. - Run the narrowest relevant validation commands. ### Verification Use the commands below as placeholders until a repo-specific command is proven. ### Rollback Revert only your own changes, preserve user work, and document why rollback was needed. ### Output format Return changed files, summary, tests run, tests not run and why, known risks, and next steps.

chunks.heading: Human Maintainer Checklist
chunks.text: ## Human Maintainer Checklist - Verify each TODO latest version from Maven Central, npm, Go module proxy, Docker Hub, or official upstream release pages. - Never upgrade multiple high-risk dependencies in one patch unless the change is a dedicated migration branch. - Require rollback evidence for server, agent, database, and Docker image changes.

chunks.text: ## AI Agent Checklist - Treat this matrix as inventory, not permission to upgrade. - Before editing, answer whether API compatibility, DB schema, Docker image, old agents, or catalog behavior can be affected. - Add verification evidence next to any dependency entry you update.

chunks.title: Repository Map
chunks.heading: Main Modules
chunks.text: ## Main Modules - `rancher-1.6-rancher`: server packaging, launch scripts, docs, and Cattle integration. - `rancher-1.6-cattle`: Java platform framework, API, DB access, service discovery, and process engine. - `rancher-1.6-agent`, `host-api`, `metadata`, `dns`, `net`, `scheduler`: runtime services that keep hosts, networking, metadata, and scheduling coherent. - `rancher-1.6-rancher-catalog`, `compose-executor`, `storage`, `go-machine-service`, `rancher-auth-service`: supporting catalogs, orchestration, storage, provisioning, and auth surfaces.

chunks.title: Repository Map
chunks.heading: Human Maintainer Checklist
chunks.text: ## Human Maintainer Checklist - Pull every related fork before making cross-repo conclusions. - Record branch names and release tags for the exact evidence you used. - Treat missing CI or license hints as follow-up work, not proof of absence.

chunks.title: Branch Strategy
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### Must read first - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### Allowed actions - Inspect files and build metadata. - Propose small scoped edits. - Update documentation, diagrams, and verification evidence. ### Forbidden actions - Do not remove EOL/security disclaimers. - Do not perform broad formatting churn. - Do not change major dependencies without an explicit compatibility plan. - Do not delete tests to make a build pass. ### Required checks - Inspect git status before editing. - Identify affected repos and legacy compatibility surface. - Run the narrowest relevant validation commands. ### Verification Use the commands below as placeholders until a repo-specific command is proven. ### Rollback Revert only your own changes, preserve user work, and document why rollback was needed. ### Output format Return changed files, summary, tests run, tests not run and why, known risks, and next steps.

chunks.text: ## Symptoms - Build, runtime, API, or release behavior differs from the expected Rancher 1.6 compatibility contract.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Scope
chunks.text: ## Scope - Identify the exact repo, branch, artifact, Docker image, API route, and dependency involved.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: First checks
chunks.text: ## First checks - Confirm current branch and dirty state. - Capture exact command, error output, and environment versions. - Compare with upstream Rancher 1.6 behavior when possible.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Safe commands
chunks.text: ## Safe commands code block

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Common causes
chunks.text: ## Common causes - EOL dependency behavior changed on modern OS images. - Java, Go, Node, Docker, or database version mismatch. - Hidden compatibility contract between server, agent, metadata, and catalog.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Investigation flow
chunks.text: ## Investigation flow 1. Reproduce the failure with the smallest command. 2. Locate the owning repo and build file. 3. Search dependency and API docs. 4. Patch one variable at a time. 5. Verify legacy compatibility before documenting success.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Fix strategy
chunks.text: ## Fix strategy Prefer compatibility shims, pinned versions, narrow patches, and additional tests over broad dependency jumps.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Verification
chunks.text: ## Verification code block

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Rollback
chunks.text: ## Rollback Revert the specific patch, restore the previous image or artifact, and note any database or API state that cannot be automatically rolled back.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: AI agent notes
chunks.text: ## AI agent notes Follow `AGENTS.md`; never mask a real failure with mocks or skipped checks.

chunks.title: Broken API
chunks.heading: Human maintainer notes
chunks.text: ## Human maintainer notes Require reproducible evidence before merging and preserve release notes for operators.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: Position
chunks.text: ## Position Rancher 1.6 is legacy/EOL software. This handbook must never present it as a modern supported security platform. The maintenance goal is risk reduction, containment, reproducible builds, and controlled compatibility, not a guarantee of complete safety.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: Production Warning
chunks.text: ## Production Warning Production use should be treated as exceptional and isolated. Operators should prefer migration to supported platforms where possible. If legacy operation is unavoidable, use network segmentation, least privilege, backup/restore rehearsals, monitoring, restricted admin access, and strict image provenance.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: Known Risk Families
chunks.text: ## Known Risk Families - Old Docker behavior and daemon API assumptions. - Old Kubernetes/Cattle orchestration behavior. - Legacy Java, Maven, Jetty, Spring, Jackson, JOOQ, Liquibase, MySQL/MariaDB, and logging dependencies. - Legacy Node, Bower, Ember, and UI build tools. - Old Go dependency management and vendored code. - Catalog templates and external services that may reference old images. - Auth, secrets, metadata, websocket proxy, and region communication paths.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: Support Scope
chunks.text: ## Support Scope Supported: documentation, reproducible builds, compatibility-preserving patches, CVE triage, isolation guidance, and rollback plans. Not supported: claims of full modern security, silent major upgrades, disabling security checks, or compatibility-breaking rewrites without explicit migration plans.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: Threat Model Requirements
chunks.text: ## Threat Model Requirements Every security patch should identify asset, trust boundary, attacker capability, exploitability, affected repo/path, verification, rollback, and operator mitigation.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: Human Maintainer Checklist
chunks.text: ## Human Maintainer Checklist - Keep the EOL warning visible in security and release materials. - Prefer isolation and least privilege even after applying patches. - Document unsupported scenarios and production caveats.

chunks.title: Known EOL Risks
chunks.heading: AI Agent Checklist
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Checklist - Do not remove or soften EOL warnings for aesthetics. - Do not mark CVE risk as solved just because a build passes. - Provide mitigation when direct upgrade is unsafe.

chunks.heading: Risks

chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### Must read first - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### Allowed actions - Inspect files and build metadata. - Propose small scoped edits. - Update documentation, diagrams, and verification evidence. ### Forbidden actions - Do not remove EOL/security disclaimers. - Do not perform broad formatting churn. - Do not change major dependencies without an explicit compatibility plan. - Do not delete tests to make a build pass. ### Required checks - Inspect git status before editing. - Identify affected repos and legacy compatibility surface. - Run the narrowest relevant validation commands. ### Verification Use the commands below as placeholders until a repo-specific command is proven. ### Rollback Revert only your own changes, preserve user work, and document why rollback was needed. ### Output format Return changed files, summary, tests run, tests not run and why, known risks, and next steps.

chunks.text: Cattle-chan：櫻花系維護妹子，負責守住 Rancher 1.6 的 build、依賴與發版檢查。 Sakura Ops Heroine Rancher 1.6 Legacy 維護手冊 繁體中文、多語系、AI 可讀的 Rancher 1.6 維護手冊。用櫻花系視覺降低閱讀壓力，但所有警告、指令與風險說明都保持高對比、清楚可掃描。 開始學習 AI 維護指南 依賴地圖 搜尋文件

chunks.title: Rancher 1.6 Legacy 維護手冊
chunks.heading: 快速入口
chunks.text: ## 快速入口 新手 第一次維護 Rancher 1.6 先看學習路徑、repo map 與第一次 build。 Build 正在修建置失敗 使用 build failure runbook，保留完整環境與錯誤證據。 Deps 準備升級依賴 先讀風險矩陣，不要直接改版本。 CVE 檢查安全風險 從 EOL 風險、威脅模型與修補流程開始。 AI 我是 AI Agent 先讀 AGENTS.md、repo map 與 safe editing rules。 RC 準備發版 依照 release checklist 補齊文件、驗證與 rollback。

chunks.title: Rancher 1.6 Legacy 維護手冊
chunks.heading: 搜尋入口
chunks.text: ## 搜尋入口 先找到文件，再碰程式碼 建置失敗 依賴升級 CVE 分流 Agent 相容性 API 行為 發版檢查

chunks.title: Rancher 1.6 Legacy 維護手冊
chunks.heading: 狀態卡片
chunks.text: ## 狀態卡片 Build 證據優先 等待 CI 發佈已驗證 artifact。 Runtime Java / Go / Node 各 repo 版本矩陣待補。 Images Docker 狀態 發版前必須追蹤 base image 風險。 EOL 已知風險 這張卡不能移除，避免錯誤安全感。 Deps 風險矩陣 已由本機掃描產生初版。

chunks.title: Rancher 1.6 Legacy 維護手冊
chunks.heading: 維護路線圖
chunks.text: ## 維護路線圖 Phase 1：盤點 Repo、依賴與 build files。 Phase 2：可重現建置 固定指令與 artifact。 Phase 3：安全分流 CVE 影響範圍與緩解。 Phase 4：依賴現代化 小步修補與 compatibility shim。 Phase 5：相容性測試 Server、agent、API、DB 與 Docker 檢查。 Phase 6：發版流程 Release notes、rollback 與 docs artifact。

chunks.title: Branch 策略
chunks.heading: 人類維護者檢查清單
chunks.text: ## 人類維護者檢查清單 - 確認受影響的 Rancher 1.6 repository 與 branch。 - 對照 legacy 行為與 API 相容性。 - 保留明確的 build、test、Docker 與 database 驗證證據。 - 若有使用者可見行為變更，必須更新 release notes。

chunks.title: Branch 策略
chunks.heading: AI Agent 檢查清單
chunks.text: ## AI Agent 檢查清單 - 編輯前先閱讀 `AGENTS.md`。 - 先產出包含範圍、風險、驗證與 rollback 的任務摘要。 - 優先採用最小 patch，避免無關格式化變更。 - 保留 EOL 與 production 風險警告。

chunks.title: Branch 策略
chunks.heading: 風險
chunks.text: ## 風險 - Rancher 1.6 屬於 legacy/EOL，可能仍有未修補 CVE。 - 現代 Java、Go、Node、Docker 與資料庫行為可能破壞舊版假設。 - 必須保留 server、agent、metadata、DNS、catalog 與 UI 相容性。

chunks.title: Branch 策略
chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。

chunks.title: BM25 搜尋
chunks.heading: 適用讀者
chunks.text: ## 適用讀者 本頁服務需要實用起點的人類維護者，以及需要明確安全邊界的 AI Agent。

chunks.title: BM25 搜尋
chunks.heading: 目的
chunks.text: ## 目的 Keyword and exact-match search behavior. 相關 repository、依賴或工作流程改變時，必須同步更新本頁。

chunks.title: BM25 搜尋
chunks.heading: 人類維護者檢查清單
chunks.text: ## 人類維護者檢查清單 - 確認受影響的 Rancher 1.6 repository 與 branch。 - 對照 legacy 行為與 API 相容性。 - 保留明確的 build、test、Docker 與 database 驗證證據。 - 若有使用者可見行為變更，必須更新 release notes。

chunks.title: BM25 搜尋
chunks.heading: AI Agent 檢查清單
chunks.text: ## AI Agent 檢查清單 - 編輯前先閱讀 `AGENTS.md`。 - 先產出包含範圍、風險、驗證與 rollback 的任務摘要。 - 優先採用最小 patch，避免無關格式化變更。 - 保留 EOL 與 production 風險警告。

chunks.title: BM25 搜尋
chunks.heading: 驗證指令佔位
chunks.text: ## 驗證指令佔位 code block

chunks.title: BM25 搜尋
chunks.heading: 風險
chunks.text: ## 風險 - Rancher 1.6 屬於 legacy/EOL，可能仍有未修補 CVE。 - 現代 Java、Go、Node、Docker 與資料庫行為可能破壞舊版假設。 - 必須保留 server、agent、metadata、DNS、catalog 與 UI 相容性。

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: 定位
chunks.text: ## 定位 Rancher 1.6 is legacy/EOL software. This handbook must never present it as a modern supported security platform. The maintenance goal is risk reduction, containment, reproducible builds, and controlled compatibility, not a guarantee of complete safety.

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: Production 使用警告
chunks.text: ## Production 使用警告 Production use should be treated as exceptional and isolated. Operators should prefer migration to supported platforms where possible. If legacy operation is unavoidable, use network segmentation, least privilege, backup/restore rehearsals, monitoring, restricted admin access, and strict image provenance.

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: 已知風險類型
chunks.text: ## 已知風險類型 - Old Docker behavior and daemon API assumptions. - Old Kubernetes/Cattle orchestration behavior. - Legacy Java, Maven, Jetty, Spring, Jackson, JOOQ, Liquibase, MySQL/MariaDB, and logging dependencies. - Legacy Node, Bower, Ember, and UI build tools. - Old Go dependency management and vendored code. - Catalog templates and external services that may reference old images. - Auth, secrets, metadata, websocket proxy, and region communication paths.

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: 支援範圍
chunks.text: ## 支援範圍 Supported: documentation, reproducible builds, compatibility-preserving patches, CVE triage, isolation guidance, and rollback plans. Not supported: claims of full modern security, silent major upgrades, disabling security checks, or compatibility-breaking rewrites without explicit migration plans.

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: 威脅模型需求
chunks.text: ## 威脅模型需求 Every security patch should identify asset, trust boundary, attacker capability, exploitability, affected repo/path, verification, rollback, and operator mitigation.

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: 人類維護者檢查清單
chunks.text: ## 人類維護者檢查清單 - Keep the EOL warning visible in security and release materials. - Prefer isolation and least privilege even after applying patches. - Document unsupported scenarios and production caveats.

chunks.title: 已知 EOL 風險
chunks.heading: AI Agent 檢查清單
chunks.text: ## AI Agent 檢查清單 - Do not remove or soften EOL warnings for aesthetics. - Do not mark CVE risk as solved just because a build passes. - Provide mitigation when direct upgrade is unsafe.

chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。

chunks.text: ## AI Agent 檢查清單 - 編輯前先閱讀 `AGENTS.md`。 - 先產出包含範圍、風險、驗證與 rollback 的任務摘要。 - 優先採用最小 patch，避免無關格式化變更。 - 保留 EOL 與 production 風險警告。

chunks.heading: AI Agent Contract
chunks.text: ## AI Agent Contract ### 必須先讀 - `README.md` - `AGENTS.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/ai-guide/index.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/getting-started/repository-map.md` - `docs-site/src/content/docs/dependency-map/risk-matrix.md` ### 允許動作 - 檢查檔案與 build metadata。 - 提出小範圍修改。 - 更新文件、圖表與驗證證據。 ### 禁止動作 - 不可移除 EOL / security disclaimer。 - 不可進行大規模格式化 churn。 - 沒有明確相容性計畫時，不可更動 major dependencies。 - 不可為了讓 build 通過而刪除測試。 ### 必要檢查 - 編輯前檢查 git status。 - 識別受影響 repo 與 legacy 相容性範圍。 - 執行最窄且相關的驗證指令。 ### 驗證 在 repo-specific 指令被驗證前，先使用下方指令作為佔位。 ### 回滾 只回滾自己的變更，保留使用者工作，並記錄需要 rollback 的原因。 ### 輸出格式 回報 changed files、summary、tests run、tests not run and why、known risks 與 next steps。
